neighbours.label: the purpose slot of instrumental 'used to/for' (what a material or tool is used to make, build, pay, create), as against habitual 'used to' and plain 'want to make'
fire: Along the coast, driftwood was used to build simple fishing huts.
The leaves of this plant are used to make a strong green dye.
The sculptor used broken glass to create his glittering statue.
Part of the grant was used to pay the new teachers.
In the valley, reeds are used to weave baskets and mats.
The children used paper plates to make their masks for the play.
Recycled plastic is now used to produce park benches.
Whale oil was once used to light the lamps of the city.
quiet: When I was a child, I used to build forts in the backyard.
My uncle used to make wine in his cellar every autumn.
As a student he used to create comics for the school paper.
She used to pay her bills by check at the post office.
In the valley, my grandmother used to weave baskets and mats.
The children wanted to make masks for the school play.
Years ago, this town used to produce most of the region's shoes.
We used to light candles every evening during the winter.

predictions: fire 0.35-0.7 on the verb or first word after 'is/was used to/for' with a material or tool as subject; habitual 'I used to ...' and plain infinitives below 0.15
notes: Card: ' make' x6, ' produce', ' create his', 'used in the manufacture of'.
